user.title: Set up Allegro
user.description: Allegro has no sign-in for apps, so this uses your browser's session. On allegro.pl, signed in, open the developer tools (F12) → Application (Chrome) or Storage (Firefox) → Cookies → allegro.pl, and copy the value of QXLSESSID.

reauth_confirm.title: Allegro session expired
reauth_confirm.description: Allegro no longer accepts the stored session cookie. Allegro has no sign-in for apps, so this uses your browser's session. On allegro.pl, signed in, open the developer tools (F12) → Application (Chrome) or Storage (Firefox) → Cookies → allegro.pl, and copy the value of QXLSESSID.

error.invalid_auth: Allegro rejected this cookie. Copy a fresh one.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Allegro. Please try again.

abort.already_configured: That Allegro account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That cookie belongs to a different Allegro account. Use the account this entry was set up for.

data_description.delivered_filter_type: Show delivered parcels from the last X days, or limit to the X most recent.
data_description.delivered_filter_amount: Number of days or parcels to show.

data_description.hand_off: When a parcel's courier has its own integration (InPost, DPD, GLS, ORLEN Paczka, Poczta Polska), add the waybill there too, with the item name. Allegro One parcels always stay here.

trigger_type.parcel_delivery_time_changed: A parcel's expected delivery time changed

update_contents.name: Update parcel contents
update_contents.description: Set what is in a parcel, in your own words, for a tracking code. An empty text clears it.

tracking_code.name: Tracking code
tracking_code.description: The tracking code of the parcel.

contents.name: Contents
contents.description: What is in the parcel, in your own words. An empty text clears it.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The account to store this for. Needed when no account lists the code yet.

update_contents_entry_required.message: No account lists this code. Choose the account to store it for.

carrier_not_set_up.title: {carrier} integration not set up
carrier_not_set_up.description: Some of your Allegro parcels travel with {carrier}. Install and set up the {carrier} integration to get its delivery window, pickup point and history: {url}. The parcels stay listed by Allegro meanwhile. To stop this, turn off hand-off in the Allegro options.
